title: Core Marketing and Sales Skills
overview: This course provides a comprehensive opportunity to refresh core marketing and sales practices, demonstrating how these two disciplines can work together to create synergy and provide a significant competitive edge in today's marketplace. Participants will gain essential knowledge and skills in one cohesive program, positioning themselves to drive business success.
audience: The course is ideal for professionals in marketing, PR, communications, sales, and operations. It caters to individuals seeking to build foundational skills in marketing and sales, as well as those looking to further develop their expertise in these areas.
methodology: The course combines classical concepts with practical tools, including self-assessments, templates, group exercises, and videos. These elements help participants acquire essential marketing and sales skills and apply them professionally and seamlessly.
objectivesIntro: By the end of the course, participants will be able to:
objectives: Understand the roles of marketing and sales and how they integrate within a business
Conduct a thorough marketing audit to assess both internal and external environments and develop a cohesive marketing plan
Combine online and offline marketing campaigns through a solid grasp of digital marketing platforms and functions
Master the sales process and create sales opportunity plans to boost revenue and profitability
Develop performance metrics for both marketing and sales to ensure alignment with business objectives
